name: maybe_Battle_PickUnitNearAverageLevel
summary: Chooses a random candidate among the 0x413 entries of the work+0x2857C table whose level lies within about +/-30% of the average party level; the action id in desc+0xC selects one of four weight tables which pick a sector (0..3) and the battle RNG picks the final entry.
evidence: func_0035EB98(...)->f_D8 (member level) is averaged, accepted band is average +/- 0.3*average, scan keeps entries where func_00...; callers Model_CreateActorModel and BattleScene_RefreshCommandWidgets.

evidence: Three callers are all named item-panel refreshes (Ui_EquipmentWindow_OpenItemPage, Ui_EquipRow_Refresh, Ui_ItemPanel_RefreshFromConditions) passing the UI manager and an item id; several callee names doubtful so exact rule unclear.

name: maybe_BattleAi_PickRandomTargetAboveDamage
signature: void* maybe_BattleAi_PickRandomTargetAboveDamage(void* aiCtx, u32 skillId, void* preferredTarget)
summary: Target picker for the battle AI: walks the 16 target-unit buckets, keeps those alive and accepting the given skill (vtable +0x18/+0xF8/+0xFC), estimates damage with Battle_ApplyDamageClamp and returns one of the units whose damage exceeds the record threshold at +0x147, chosen with the battle RNG; falls back to the preferred target.
evidence: Caller BattleAi_FilterUsableCandidates assigns result to a single candidate pointer; BattleAi_SelectActionForMode also calls it; uses Battle_ApplyDamageClamp and battle RNG.

name: maybe_Field2D_Object_NeedsUpdate
summary: Active/needs-processing gate for a Field2D object: returns 0 only when the interface at +0x88 reports idle and both idle checks pass, else 1.
evidence: Two idle checks 0x00669B68/0x00669B7C plus vtable call through +0x88; used by Field2D_Scene_RenderObjects and txf as a gate; container class at +0x88 unnamed.

name: maybe_Battle_RollHitRateByTemplate

summary: Resolves the action's 0x1D-class combat-modifier entry from an 8-entry template (0x2C stride, kind at +0x58), computes the chance with Battle_ResolveMemberCombatModifiers and compares a 1..100 battle-RNG roll against it; returns 1 when the roll passes.
evidence: Callee Battle_ResolveMemberCombatModifiers produces threshold, func_001CA474(battle RNG,1,100) rolls; template stride 0x2C with kind byte +0x58 == 0x1D; called from Battle_ActionSequence_DispatchActorState.

name: Battle_CheckTargetReceivesAction

summary: Decides whether an action can resolve against a target: rejects on action-row block flag, target states 0x6F/0x70/0xFF, or status gate, otherwise rolls 1..100 battle RNG against the computed chance modifier and returns 1 on success.
evidence: Action row via func_0063FD24, vtable +0xE8 status tests 0x6F/0x70/0xFF, Battle_ResolveMemberCombatModifiers chance, RNG at battle+0x4218; called from Battle_ActorAction_ShowDamage and Battle_Ui_UpdateMessageSequence.

evidence: SkillRecord wrapper func_0018C1B8 fields f_CE/f_DE/f_E2/f_CC, Battle_ResolveMemberCombatModifiers, RNG at battle+0x4218, callee maybe_Battle_RollStatusProc; caller Battle_Ui_ShowActionEffectMessage.

name: maybe_Sys_InitCommandRings

summary: Initialises a render session: fills two 256-entry command rings with entry pointers, starts each ring's mixing state and gfx command ring (one per 3DS screen), stores screen parameters and builds the 16-button pad mapping.
evidence: Calls Snd_InitMixingState and Gfx_InitCommandRing once per ring (rings at +0x35C/+0x790 and +0x1BCC/+0x2000) and loops i<0x100 pushing entry pointers; tail maps 16 mask words via func_00112448. Body is damaged (std_memmove(0) noreturn artifacts, fake f_17c0/f_2830 fields), so no disassembly confirmation of the ring layout; keep maybe_ at <=0.3.

name: maybe_Input_UpdatePadStateThumb

signature: void maybe_Gfx_CommandListWorker(u32 arg1, u32 mask, int count, u32* d, int header, int* state)

name: Gfx_WaitForDisplayStateE
summary: Selects display state 0x0E through 0x001139F0 and then polls Gfx_IpcCmd2B0000 with 10 ms sleeps until the GPU IPC answer is no longer one of the three transient busy codes 0xC8A0CFF0 / 0xE0A0CC08 / 0xC8A0CC02.
evidence: Polled getter is named Gfx_IpcCmd2B0000; the three transient codes match the gfx IPC busy codes; 0x0E selector passed to 0x001139F0; callers Gfx_UpdateDisplayState/B and maybe_Gfx_HandleVBlank.

name: Svc_Ir_SetupChannel

summary: Opens the ir:USER session on first use, maps shared memory, sends the channel setup IPC request and initialises the endpoint, cleaning up on failure.
evidence: Service-name literal 'ir:USER' verified; guarded one-time init with Os_MapSharedMemory, Svc_Ir_IpcCmd180182 and Os_CloseHandle cleanup; callers Gfx_OpenGpuChannel and Snd_CreateChannelBuffers are generic users of the shared session.

name: maybe_Field_InitSharedParams
